positions.commentary: The speaker states that Meta used to hire only engineers from Stanford, MIT, or Harvard, but that practice has ended.
Google conducts its own testing and does not rely on college degrees for ranking candidates.

thesis: The episode argues that the traditional higher education model is in crisis, noting that top tech companies like Meta and Google have shifted away from hiring exclusively from elite universities. Instead, these firms now conduct their own testing and rank candidates equally regardless of whether they hold college degrees.
